events.label: South Carolina judge rejects California request to stop Vylor spinoff

slots.name: emergency request status
slots.sentence: A federal judge in South Carolina on Wednesday rejected California's emergency request to stop the spinoff from going forward.

events.label: Fifteen states sue Corteva over Vylor spinoff

slots.name: number of suing states
slots.sentence: Fifteen US states sued agrichemicals company Corteva (CTVA.N) on Thursday, alleging that the spinoff of its seed and genetics business into Vylor (VYLR.N) was designed to shield the company's best assets from tens of billions of dollars in potential liabilities tied to PFAS "forever chemicals" that have polluted the environment.

slots.name: spinoff completion date
slots.sentence: Corteva completed the Vylor spinoff into a separate publicly traded company on Thursday.
